New shelter dog day-out programs: November 2026

558 shelter day-out, field trip, sleepover and hiking programs added to ShelterDayOut in November 2026, by state. Each one comes from the shelter's own website.

November 2026 is when we started keeping this list, so it includes every program in the directory at that time.

ShelterDayOut is a free directory. We don't run outings or handle bookings; each shelter sets its own rules. Listings are checked monthly, but details change, so confirm with the shelter before you go.

Ready to adopt? ShelterAdoption, our sister site, lists every shelter near you plus upcoming adoption events.
